name: Unit Telecom LLP
note: Holds 75% of Transtelecom. Nurali Aliyev (grandson of ex-president Nazarbayev) built the stake to 75% by 2021, Galimzhan Yessenov's Jusan Mobile bought 51% of Unit Telecom in December 2024, and Aliyev completed his exit in August 2025 (press). On 11 December 2025 Transtelecom shareholders began a transfer of control to Timur Turlov's entities (Future Telecom Limited), pending regulatory approvals.
